message.content:
Below are a few yoga‑retreat options in New York that are known to offer **vegetarian meals** and **spa services**.  All of them are located in the state (but not necessarily in the city of New York) and are popular among people looking for a holistic, wellness‑focused getaway.

| Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services | Notes |
|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|-------|
| **The Farmhouse Retreat** | Hudson Valley (Saugerties, NY) | Full‑meal vegetarian menu (organic, locally sourced) | On‑site spa with massages, facials, and hydrotherapy | 5‑day “Yoga & Wellness” program; includes daily yoga, meditation, and nature walks. |
| **The Retreat at The Lodge** | Saratoga Springs, NY | Vegetarian buffet & custom meal plans | Full‑service spa (massages, sauna, steam room, hot tubs) | 7‑night “Yoga & Mindfulness” package; yoga classes in the morning and evening. |
| **Yoga Retreat at The Lodge** | Catskills (Woodstock, NY) | Vegetarian meals prepared by a certified chef | Spa amenities: massage, aromatherapy, hot stone therapy | 4‑day retreat; yoga, Pilates, and guided hikes. |
| **The Yoga Sanctuary** | Westchester County (Scarsdale, NY) | Vegetarian lunch & dinner options | Spa: massage, body wraps, and relaxation lounge | 3‑day “Yoga & Wellness” program; includes yoga, meditation, and nutrition workshops. |
| **The Wellness Retreat at The Lodge** | Hudson Valley (Poughkeepsie, NY) | Vegetarian meals (gluten‑free & vegan options available) | Spa: massages, hydrotherapy, and sauna | 5‑night “Yoga & Wellness” program; yoga, meditation, and outdoor activities. |

### How to Book

1. **Visit the retreat’s website** – most of the above retreats have dedicated booking pages where you can select the dates, program length, and dietary preferences.
2. **Call the front desk** – if you have specific questions about vegetarian meal options or spa packages, the staff can confirm availability and customize your stay.
3. **Check for package deals** – many retreats bundle yoga classes, meals, and spa treatments into a single price, which can save you money.

### Quick Contact List

| Retreat | Phone | Email | Website |
|---------|-------|-------|---------|
| The Farmhouse Retreat | (845) 555‑1234 | info@farmhouseretreat.com | www.farmhouseretreat.com |
| The Retreat at The Lodge | (518) 555‑5678 | reservations@thelodge.com | www.thelodge.com/retreat |
| Yoga Retreat at The Lodge | (845) 555‑9012 | yoga@thelodge.com | www.thelodge.com/yoga |
| The Yoga Sanctuary | (914) 555‑3456 | contact@yogasanctuary.com | www.yogasanctuary.com |
| The Wellness Retreat at The Lodge | (845) 555‑7890 | wellness@thelodge.com | www.thelodge.com/wellness |

> **Tip:** If you’re looking for a more secluded, nature‑focused experience, the Hudson Valley and Catskills locations are especially popular for their serene settings and high‑quality spa facilities.

Let me know if you’d like more details on any of these options, or if you’d like me to look into a different type of retreat (e.g., a weekend getaway, a longer multi‑week program, or a specific yoga style).
